text: The following question stood in the name of Ms Yip Pin Xiu – 13 To ask the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (a) what are the sporting targets that are set out for the Singapore Sports School to achieve in the next three years; (b) whether the Singapore Sports School has reached their annual targets in the past three years; (c) which are the top three schools that will have the most athletes representing Singapore in the 2019 SEA Games; (d) how many athletes are from these respective schools; and (e) how many athletes are from the Singapore Sports School.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: To this end, the school provides a strong academic and sport development programme that meets the needs of its students, develops their character and enables them to excel in their sport.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: MCCY, Sport Singapore and the Ministry of Education do not track the originating schools of all Team Singapore athletes and neither is this a requirement by the Singapore National Olympic Council.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: The Sports School has consistently done better than national average in terms of the percentage of students who passed five or more subjects at the GCE "O" level examinations and better than the global average in the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme score.
